form.label: Check Detail
form.description: Per-check documentation, implementation guidance, validation, and current status.

search.query: | inputlookup framework_catalog.csv | lookup ccp_framework_selections framework_key OUTPUT selected | eval selected_value=tostring(coalesce(selected,default_selected)), selected=if(selected_value="1" OR selected_value="true",1,0) | search status=active selected=1 | fields framework_key framework_name
| inputlookup requirements.csv | search framework_key="$framework_token$" | fields requirement_key title

div.span: Framework: choose the framework that owns the check. Changing it clears the previous check. i
Check: the definition, criteria, evidence, and assessment panels follow this choice. i
System key: leave * to review evidence and assessments across all systems. i

html.div: Review sequence: read the check definition, follow the implementation steps, run the stated validation method, review current evidence, then record an assessment decision.

search.query: | inputlookup requirements.csv | search framework_key="$framework_token$" requirement_key="$requirement_token$" | lookup policy_playbook.csv framework_key requirement_key OUTPUT implementation_title implementation_steps validation_method owner_role common_gap | lookup framework_assessment_profiles.csv framework_key OUTPUT assessment_granularity assessment_methods scoring_model required_artifacts audit_boundary authority_statement | table title category requirement_type verification_label verification_guidance description source_reference evidence_types implementation_title implementation_steps validation_method owner_role common_gap assessment_granularity assessment_methods scoring_model required_artifacts audit_boundary authority_statement assessment_method_reference assessment_objective applicability pass_criteria partial_criteria fail_criteria | rename title as Check category as Category requirement_type as Type verification_label as "How to prove it" verification_guidance as "Verification guidance" description as "What is being checked" source_reference as "Source reference" evidence_types as "Evidence expected" implementation_title as "Implementation" implementation_steps as "Steps to implement" validation_method as "How to validate" owner_role as "Suggested owner" common_gap as "Common gap" assessment_granularity as "Assessment level" assessment_methods as "Assessment methods" scoring_model as "Decision model" required_artifacts as "Artifacts expected" audit_boundary as "Audit boundary" authority_statement as "Content status" assessment_method_reference as "Method reference" assessment_objective as "Assessment objective" applicability as Applicability pass_criteria as "Pass criteria" partial_criteria as "Partial criteria" fail_criteria as "Fail criteria" | transpose | rename column AS " ", "row *" AS " *"

| inputlookup requirements.csv | search framework_key="$framework_token$" requirement_key="$requirement_token$" | table level_1 level_2 level_3 level_4 | rename level_1 as "Level 1" level_2 as "Level 2" level_3 as "Level 3" level_4 as "Level 4" | transpose | rename column AS " ", "row *" AS " *"

| inputlookup ccp_assessments | search framework_key="$framework_token$" requirement_key="$requirement_token$" | where "$system_token$"="*" OR system_key="$system_token$" | sort 0 - assessed_at | head 1 | table system_key status score assessor assessed_at notes | rename system_key as System status as Status score as Score assessor as Assessor assessed_at as "Assessed at" notes as Notes

| inputlookup ccp_evidence | search framework_key="$framework_token$" requirement_key="$requirement_token$" | where "$system_token$"="*" OR system_key="$system_token$" | sort 0 - collected_at | table system_key evidence_type title owner status collected_at expires_at location | rename system_key as System evidence_type as Type title as Evidence owner as Owner status as Status collected_at as Collected expires_at as Expires location as Reference

html.div: Audit rule: select Pass only when the implementation is in place, the validation method has been executed, and current evidence is attached. A policy document alone is not sufficient.
